correctness.rationale: Adjunction and anticanonical ampleness force any geometric negative irreducible curve to be a (-1)-curve. The five-point blowup gives the stated 16 curves, with pairwise intersections 0 or 1. Negative definiteness is exactly disjointness. Conversely, contracting a disjoint set and taking a pullback of an ample class plus small positive multiples of those curves gives a big class with precisely that negative support, with a full-dimensional chamber by openness of ampleness on the contraction and of the positive coefficients. This argument uses no characteristic-zero restriction. The intersection graph is the folded cube: its five neighbors of zero determine the full automorphism group (the other ten vertices are determined by distinct pairs of neighbors), and the even translations and coordinate permutations realize all 1920 automorphisms. The Weyl action is faithful because the curve classes span the Picard group. Independently using F_2^5 modulo the all-ones vector, I enumerated conjugation orbits of the actual 16-vertex permutations, computed invariant supports on the conflict graph of curve cycles, and inverted fixed counts of powers to recover the chamber cycle multiplicities. It matches every column of all 18 rows of spectra.csv, including the 393 supports, 18 distinct chamber spectra, 12 distinct line spectra, ten rational counts, and both collision examples. Replay: python3 /workspace/audit_evidence/chambers.py <frozen spectra.csv>. Mobius inversion on extension counts gives exactly the finite etale zeta reconstruction, not reconstruction of X. Trepalin arXiv:1803.07421v1 Thm. 1.4 and §6/Table 4 were read: the stated exclusions are only over F_2 and F_3. Although his type is a cyclic subgroup conjugacy class, all generators of a given cyclic subgroup of W(D_5) are conjugate: a coprime power preserves the permutation cycle lengths and each negative cycle's parity (its signed order is even), and these signed types are the verified element classes. Thus realization of all 18 for q>=4 follows as written; the ten counts are the overall possible values, not a realization claim for each of q=2,3.
